purpose: Add the missing statistical reporting contract to the already executed T197/T198 paper-data analyses without refitting models or changing a frozen target set.

T197_primary.analysis_population: Each held-out laboratory-anchor fold; the target set is the exact intersection of rank-eligible accessions in the two development sources.
T197_primary.prediction_row: one source-local rank-percentile observation for one frozen canonical accession
T197_primary.primary_metric: arithmetic mean of held-out measurement-batch Spearman correlations within each outer fold
T197_primary.primary_contrast: paired batch-level full-sequence ridge minus composition-only ridge
T197_primary.uncertainty: percentile bootstrap over held-out measurement batches, 2,000 resamples per fold/model/metric

T198_primary.analysis_population: The 141 biological units represented in the CC-BY paper-attached cohort at the predeclared threshold of at least 10 mapped positive proteins per subject-particle batch.
T198_primary.prediction_row: one source-local rank-percentile observation for one mapped canonical accession
T198_primary.primary_metric: subject-equal mean Spearman: average batch Spearman within each biological unit, then average equally over biological units
T198_primary.primary_contrast: full-sequence ridge versus composition-only ridge; paired batch delta is secondary
T198_primary.uncertainty: percentile bootstrap over biological units, 2,000 resamples

T197_outer_fold_negative_control.family: three outer-fold negative-control p-values for the predeclared full-model primary metric
T197_outer_fold_negative_control.all_other_results: descriptive only; no threshold, model, fold or secondary metric is treated as confirmatory

T198_threshold_grid.adjustment: no confirmatory p-value; report all settings descriptively with intervals
T198_threshold_grid.primary: threshold 10 is the only predeclared primary setting

missingness.mechanism_claim: descriptive missingness and qualification audit; no MAR/MCAR assumption and no imputation

uncertainty.seed_derivation: T197 seed = 1970 + 1000*outer_fold_number + 100*model_index + metric_index; T198 stratum tables are deterministic counts
uncertainty.low_cluster_policy: report cluster count and retain exploratory claim boundary; do not convert batches into donor-level n

claim_boundary: T200 closes statistical reporting gaps for paper-attached exploratory analyses. It does not create independent biological validation, a protected lockbox receipt, no-author reproduction, external adoption, DOI archival evidence or scientific submission readiness.
